summary: Gaotu Techedu Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its press release announcing unaudited Q2 2026 financial results. The release covers net revenues of RMB1,670.1 million (up 20.2% YoY), gross billings of RMB2,689.1 million, and a narrowed net loss of RMB135.8 million. No special-situation event is disclosed — no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, or other corporate action. The filing is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer, with commentary from CEO Larry Xiangdong Chen on operational improvements. No deal terms or structural actions are present; this is an ordinary periodic disclosure, not a special situation.
